title: CabbageFarmSihti: from continuous world extrapolation to stochastic transfer law
summary: CabbageFarmSihti recombines the old CabbageFarm ambition of coordinate-addressable, effectively unbounded 2-D worlds with the Sihti/Sihti2 view that an operator can be inferred from what survives and bleeds out across scales. The v0 implementation deliberately begins with a stationary Gaussian spectral baseline: fit a 2-D transfer law from a finite reference, then sample a globally coordinate-addressable random Fourier field from that law. Exact overlap consistency is tested. Sihti-style Gaussian residue signatures are recorded as diagnostics, but are not counted as extra information because linear second-order octave statistics are already implied by the power spectrum. Cross-octave spatial relations are only earned if the spectral attacker fails.

nodes.claim: Uses continuous implicit neural functions to represent a finite 2-D image as a coordinate-queryable field and extrapolate beyond the observed image.
nodes.survived: The coordinate-field formulation makes pan/zoom and arbitrary-coordinate queries a concrete engineering target; the repo also explores dense complex-valued and fast Walsh-Hadamard spectral mixing.
nodes.killed: Querying outside the fitted image does not by itself establish that the model learned a stochastic law of the texture or world; the README itself describes far extrapolation as hallucination.

nodes.claim: Learns a stochastic transfer law from a finite texture and applies it to fresh coordinate-addressable noise, beginning with a 2-D spectral Gaussian-field attacker before adding Sihti cross-octave relations.
nodes.survived: v0 implements reference-to-spectral-law fitting, fresh random Fourier synthesis, exact overlap-consistent coordinate crops, power/anistropy/colour diagnostics and Sihti-style Gaussian residue fingerprints under an explicit second-order claim boundary.
nodes.killed: Matching power spectrum or linear octave-energy statistics is not treated as statistically indistinguishable natural texture synthesis; higher-order shape, phase organization and cross-octave relations remain unearned.

edges.why: CabbageFarmSihti explicitly revisits CabbageFarm's continuous/infinite-query world goal but replaces one-world implicit extrapolation with a stochastic-law-plus-noise generator.
CabbageFarmSihti explicitly imports the Sihti2 transfer-law/noise perspective: noise supplies novelty, while the learned operator and residue hierarchy describe what structure survives across scales.

motifs.title: Learn the law, not one stored world
motifs.description: CabbageFarm made a continuous coordinate representation of one fitted image. Sihti2 reframed random input as a probe of an operator-written geometry. CabbageFarmSihti combines those lines by learning a stochastic transfer law from a finite example and applying it to fresh coordinate-addressable noise, so new territory comes from the law rather than from extrapolating one stored instance.
